name: Conte
source:
A Conte type monster girl. This Conte appears to have died and lives now as a ghost. Whether all Conte monster girls are ghost types is never explained. After finding her grave [url=http://vndb.org/c10474]Leo[/url] is able to capture and tame her. She is very skilled at dark magic.

Oddly enough despite being dead she is still capable of having sex, laying eggs, and being reborn again as a ghost.
